text.title: Spring Boot Layered Architecture Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema for the service-scaffold manifest this methodology produces. Validator enforces required keys + per-field constraints. `controller`, `request_dto`, `response_dto`, `async` and `errors_use_problemdetail` are OPTIONAL blocks — omit them for a build-level audit, supply them when the artefact describes a full vertical slice, in which case every constraint inside them is enforced.

section.title: Schema

example.code: { "spring_boot_version": "3.2.1", "endpoints": [ {"path": "/api/v1/users", "method": "GET", "returns_dto": true, "list_pageable": true, "transactional_on_write": false}, {"path": "/api/v1/users", "method": "POST", "returns_dto": true, "list_pageable": null, "transactional_on_write": true} ], "controller": {"class_name": "UserController", "has_transactional": false, "calls_repository_directly": false, "service_calls_per_method": 1}, "request_dto": {"class_name": "CreateUserRequest", "is_record": true, "has_bean_validation": true}, "response_dto": {"class_name": "UserResponse", "is_record": true}, "async": {"self_invocation": false, "executor_name": "emailExecutor", "executor_bean_defined": true}, "errors_use_problemdetail": true, "uses_mapstruct": true, "uses_bcrypt_in_service": true, "jakarta_imports_only": true, "forbidden_patterns_found": [] }

{ "spring_boot_version": "2.7.0", "endpoints": [{"path": "/api/v1/users", "method": "GET", "returns_dto": false, "list_pageable": false}], "controller": {"class_name": "UserCtrl", "has_transactional": true, "calls_repository_directly": true, "service_calls_per_method": 3}, "request_dto": {"class_name": "CreateUserReq", "is_record": false, "has_bean_validation": false}, "response_dto": {"class_name": "UserResp", "is_record": false}, "async": {"self_invocation": true, "executor_name": "", "executor_bean_defined": false}, "errors_use_problemdetail": false, "uses_mapstruct": false, "uses_bcrypt_in_service": false, "jakarta_imports_only": false, "forbidden_patterns_found": ["javax.persistence.Entity import in src/main/java/.../User.java"] }
example.note: Boot 2.x; entity returned from controller; list endpoint without Pageable; controller transactional and reaching the repository directly; DTOs not records and unvalidated; async self-invoked with no named executor; bespoke error envelope; MapStruct off; BCrypt missing; javax imports present.

list.item: `@Transactional` on a controller, a repository, or a private method.
Controller autowiring a repository or orchestrating more than one service call per method.
`findAll()` without `Pageable` on a growable list endpoint.
Request DTO that is not a record, or carries no Bean Validation annotations.
`@Async` self-invoked on the same bean, or without a named `ThreadPoolTaskExecutor`.
A bespoke error envelope in place of RFC 7807 `ProblemDetail`.
`self.method()` call relying on `@Transactional` on the same bean (self-invocation bypasses the proxy).
